content: Maliyaꞌa Yesu aiyaleꞌmo uvelimo lakino faleno ateꞌniya gemae
Sigisiꞌa afinaꞌmo utesigeno Pasova hopa afinaꞌmo afole aisiyafeꞌmo huꞌniya afinaꞌmo Yesuꞌa Metani taonifiꞌmo Layosiꞌa faliꞌniyatetiꞌmo alino he tino ateꞌniya kotegamo eꞌniye.
Eꞌnigeꞌa une neꞌyaꞌmo alo huteꞌa Mataꞌa neꞌyaꞌmo alino fako huno apamiꞌnigeꞌa Layosigiꞌeꞌmo magokepi lokaeꞌa maiꞌneꞌa neꞌnae.

Maiꞌneꞌapaeꞌmo Maliyaꞌa alopa moniletiꞌmo miya nefaiya uvelimo alagepa atumo neꞌaiya uvelimo lole kapufiꞌmo nehaneya agufa uvelimo alinineno Yesu aiyalateꞌmo lakino faleno ateteno ayokatetiꞌmo alino hau huno ateꞌnigenoꞌaeꞌmo alagepa atuꞌamoꞌmo ani maiꞌnaya nopiꞌmo havai teꞌniye.
Yutasiꞌa Isakaliyoti kotega vekamo Saimoni mafaꞌneꞌamoꞌmo geꞌamo neꞌafiya vayapati vekamo kutulu yaꞌmo alisiya vekamoꞌa,
na kava higenoꞌaeꞌmo alagepa atumo neꞌaiya uvelimo alino maketi hisigeꞌa tali hataleti kinaletiꞌmo miya faitesageno alino kagemi yaꞌapimo ohaneꞌnisiya vayaꞌaina apamiyafeꞌmo huꞌniye, huno huꞌniye.
Kagemi yaꞌapimo ohaneꞌnisiya vayaꞌaifeꞌmo agesa oꞌafiꞌniyaꞌmonanafa moni kuteꞌmo neꞌyagaiya vekamo maiꞌneno kupatiꞌmo kumayaꞌmo neꞌaliya vekamo maiꞌniyaꞌmofeꞌmo ani gemo huꞌniye.
Yesuꞌa, afaꞌa ateyo. Falisugeꞌa kiꞌa natesaya afinafeꞌmo agesamo afiteno uvelimo lakino faleno nateꞌniye.
Kagemi yaꞌapimo ohaneꞌnisiya vayaꞌmo muki afinaꞌmo lapakaeꞌeꞌmo magokepi lokaetapa maigayaꞌmonanafa nagaemo muki afinaꞌmo lapakaeꞌeꞌmo magokepi lokaeta oꞌmaigune, huno hapa paiꞌniye.
Yesuꞌa eno maiꞌniye, huꞌa huꞌnaya gemo afiteꞌapaeꞌmo muki Yu vayaꞌmo Yesukeꞌmo agesayafeꞌmo oꞌmeꞌnayana Layosiꞌa faliꞌniyatetiꞌmo alino he tino ateꞌniya vekaꞌeꞌmo anakesayafeꞌmo eꞌnae.

Layosiꞌmo afaꞌa maiꞌnigeꞌa ageteꞌa muki Yu vayaꞌmogi Yesufeꞌmo apakesa afiꞌa fatago huꞌnageꞌapaeꞌmo mono huꞌa neꞌapataya vayaꞌaiteꞌmo yagaiꞌa neꞌapataya vayaꞌmogimo, Layosiꞌeꞌmo anamagigune, huꞌa huteꞌa vege huꞌa maiꞌnae.
Yesuꞌa yagaino neꞌapateya kini vekagana huno Yulusalemu taonifiꞌmo uno avaꞌyi huꞌniya gemae
Egaꞌamo asole vayaꞌmo Pasova afinaꞌmo eꞌnaya vayaꞌmogimo afiꞌnayana, Yesuꞌa Yulusalemu taonifiꞌmo neꞌe, huꞌa huꞌnaya gemo afiteꞌapaeꞌmo
uꞌa vayavekana yosamo akopaꞌamo yageꞌa aliteꞌa uꞌa fotu hisayafeꞌmo neꞌuꞌapaeꞌmo, laha mao.

content.text: Ala kava neꞌmo agiꞌaletiꞌmo neꞌeya vekamo Gotiꞌa ha maeno. Agaemo Isaleli vayaꞌaiteꞌmo yagaino neꞌapateya kini vekamae, huꞌa huꞌnae.

content: Yesuꞌa mago aikeli noki afumo agotofuleꞌmo uno haino fai maiteno eꞌniye. Goti Mukufiꞌmo avoꞌmo kae maleꞌniya gemoꞌa ani kavatefeꞌmo hunoꞌaeꞌmo,

content.text: Saiyoni taonifiꞌmo maiꞌnaya vayaꞌmogitapamo koli osiyo. Ageyo, ala vekatapimo yagaino nelapateya kini vekatapimo aikeli noki afuleꞌmo fai maiteno neꞌe,

content: huno huꞌniye.

Ani afinaꞌmo geꞌamo neꞌafiya vayaꞌmogi ani kavaꞌmo aepaꞌamo ageꞌa aeto osuꞌnayaꞌmonanafa Yesuꞌa faliꞌniyatetiꞌmo alino he tino ateꞌnigeno kokuꞌnapiꞌmo haino maiꞌnigeꞌapaekeꞌmo Yesufeꞌmo ava gemo huno avoꞌmo kae maleꞌniya ava geeꞌmo apakesamo aino halo aiꞌnigeꞌapaeꞌmo, he, ani kavaꞌmo Yesutegamo ago afole aiꞌniye, huꞌa apakesa afiꞌa ho huꞌnae.
Muki vayaꞌmogi Yesuꞌa Layosiꞌmo alino he tino ateꞌniya afinaꞌmo agaeꞌeꞌmo lokaeꞌa maiꞌneꞌa ageteꞌapaeꞌmo faigoko gemo huliꞌa uꞌeꞌa huꞌnae.
Ani noꞌagaya agufa aune kavaꞌmo huꞌniya kavafeꞌmo ava gemo huꞌnageꞌa afiꞌnayaꞌmofeꞌmo asole vayaꞌmo agaeꞌeꞌmo uꞌa fotu huꞌnae.
Falasi vayaꞌmogi apakaiꞌapimo huꞌapaeꞌmo, Lapakaemo ani vekamo aetapa oꞌagaseꞌnae. Ageyo, muki ma mopafi vayaꞌmogi akame nehae, huꞌa huꞌnae.
Galiki nofi vayaꞌmogimo Yesuꞌmo agesayafeꞌmo eꞌnaya gemae
Hopa afinaꞌmo Gotifeꞌmo mono hisayafeꞌmo Yulusalemu taonifiꞌmo uꞌa haiꞌnaya vayapatiꞌmo mago vayaꞌamo Galiki nofi vayaꞌmo maiꞌnae.
Apakaemo Filipiꞌa Galeliya kotega Metasaita taonifi vekalegamo eꞌa, lao vekae, huꞌa, Yesuꞌmo agesunafeꞌmo nehune, huꞌa afi geꞌnageno
Filipiꞌa uno Eꞌnalufeꞌmo ha paitegeꞌana Yesutegamo uꞌana ha paiꞌnaꞌae.
Yesuꞌa geꞌapileꞌmo aeno atagaina huno hapa painoꞌaeꞌmo, hemenimo Vemo Mafaꞌnemoꞌa ala agiꞌamo alisiya afinaꞌmo afole aiꞌniye.
Lama ge lapa nepauve. Avina yaꞌmo mopafiꞌmo ofaiꞌnisayana magoke avina yaꞌmo alagi hanegaiyaꞌmonanafa fai maleꞌnisageno falitenoꞌaeꞌmo halate hageteno asole avina yaꞌmo alino ategaiye.

Muki vayaꞌmogimo ma mopafi alagepa huꞌa maisaya kavafeꞌmo hapauꞌnisiyaꞌmoꞌmo afaꞌa maisaya yaꞌapimo atalegae. Muki vayaꞌmogimo ma mopafi alagepa huꞌa maisaya kavafeꞌmo ohapauꞌnisiyaꞌmoꞌmo afaꞌa maisaya yaꞌapimo oꞌataleꞌa alagepa huꞌa alagi maige maige huꞌa maigae.

Aliꞌyaꞌnileꞌmo maigefeꞌmo hisaya vayaꞌmogi nagae nakamekeꞌmo hiyo. Ani kavaꞌmo huꞌa aliꞌyaꞌnileꞌmo maiꞌnisaya vayaꞌmogi nagae nakamekeꞌmo huteꞌa uꞌna maisuva kotegamo uꞌa maigae. Inagi Afoꞌnimoꞌmo aliꞌyaꞌnileꞌmo maiꞌnisaya vayaꞌai apakiꞌapileꞌmo alino asaga huno apategaiye, huno hapa paiꞌniye.
Yesuꞌa falisiya kavafeꞌmo hapa paiꞌniya gemae
Naipamoꞌmo atete nehisigeꞌnaeꞌmo na agufa gemo huguve. Afo, huꞌna, nagaetegamo hosu kavaꞌmo afole aisiya kavaꞌmo alika atalo, huꞌna hugufiye. Haꞌao. Ani hosu kavaꞌmo alisuvafekeꞌmo emiꞌneꞌnove.
Afo, kagikaleꞌmo alika asaga huvo, huno huꞌnigeno kokuꞌnapatiꞌmo ge hunoꞌaeꞌmo, nagiꞌnileꞌmo aliꞌna asaga huꞌnovanageꞌna halate magoꞌe huꞌna nagiꞌnileꞌmo aliꞌna asaga huguve, huno huꞌniye.
Huꞌnigeꞌapaeꞌmo asole vayaꞌmo anileꞌmo he tiꞌa maiꞌneꞌa afiteꞌapaeꞌmo, hakalu huꞌniye, huꞌa huꞌnageꞌapaeꞌmo mago vayaꞌamogi, enisole vekamoꞌa ha paiꞌniye, huꞌa huꞌnayaꞌmonanafa
Yesuꞌa, ani gemo nagaefekeꞌmo osuꞌnifa lapakaeꞌefeꞌmo huꞌniye.
Hemenimo ma mopafi vayaꞌai hosu kavaꞌapimo afole aisigeno Gotiꞌa alino fako huno apategaiye. Hemenimo ma mopafi vayaꞌaiteꞌmo yagaino neꞌapateya vekamo alino hafaino atalegaiye.
Apakaemo ma mopafatiꞌmo aliꞌa he tiꞌa natetesageꞌnaeꞌmo muki vayaꞌamo nagaiꞌnilegamo aiꞌna apavayu huliꞌna egauve, huno hapa paiꞌniye.
Agaemo haiya agufa kava huꞌna faligufi, huno hapa paiꞌniye.

Asole vayaꞌmogi, lagae keꞌaepa gemoꞌa hunoꞌaeꞌmo, Kalaisi vekamo alagi maige maige huno maigiye, huno huꞌniyaꞌmonanafa na kava higekaeꞌmo Vemo Mafaꞌnemo aliꞌa he tiꞌa ategae, huka nehane. Ani Vemo Mafaꞌnemo ina laꞌmae, huꞌa afi geꞌnae.

Yesuꞌa, aise afinaꞌmo ha le yaꞌmo alino neꞌapamiya vekamo lapakaeꞌeꞌmo magokepi lokaeno maiꞌnenoꞌaeꞌmo aeno ha leno lapategaiye. Aeno ha leꞌnisiya yategamo umenitata hiyo fiku yanageno hani lapaugiyanagi. Hanipiꞌmo umenitata nehiya vekamoꞌa haiya kateꞌmo neꞌufi huno oꞌagegaiye.

Ha le yaꞌmo alino neꞌapamiya vekamo lapakaeꞌeꞌmo magokepi lokaeno maiꞌniyanagi agaefeꞌmo lapakesa afitapa fatago higenoꞌao ha le vayaꞌmo ha malegayanagi, huno hapa paiteno apataleno uno fala kino maiꞌniye.
Apakesa afiꞌa fatago osuꞌnaya kavafeꞌmo apava gemo huꞌniya gemae
Yesuꞌa asole noꞌagaya agufa aune kavaꞌmo apaulagaleꞌmo huꞌniyaꞌmonanafa agaefeꞌmo alagi apakesa afiꞌa fatago osuꞌnae.
Aiyeyaꞌa Gotitegati gemo alinineno aeno hakalo huno hapa nepaiya vekamoꞌa huꞌniya gemo afole aisiyafeꞌmo apakesa afiꞌa fatago osuꞌnae. Aiyeyaꞌa ani kavatefeꞌmo,

content.text: Ala kava nene, ina laꞌmo hapa paiꞌnona gemo afiꞌniye. Ala kava neꞌmoꞌa ina laꞌmo himamuꞌamoꞌa agufamo alino katino atesiya himamuꞌamo alino ave liꞌniye,

content: huno avoꞌmo kae maleꞌniye.
Aiyeyaꞌa ani kavatefeꞌmo magoꞌe gemo hunoꞌaeꞌmo,

content.text: Gotiꞌa apaulagaletiꞌmo oꞌagege apaipafatiꞌmo alagepa huꞌa afiꞌa aeto osuge hisayafeꞌmo apaulagamo alino fali kaeno apateteno apaipamo alino yafakana huno lokiya vaino apateꞌniye. Gotiꞌa hunoꞌaeꞌmo, nagaetegamo aiꞌa atagineꞌa esageꞌnaeꞌmo aliꞌna alagepa huꞌna oꞌapatesuvafeꞌmae, huno huꞌniye,

content: huno avoꞌmo kae maleꞌniye. Aiyeyaꞌa ani gemo huno avoꞌmo kae maleꞌniyaꞌmofeꞌmo Yesuꞌeꞌmo magokepi lokaeꞌa maiꞌnaya vayaꞌmogi afaꞌa apakesa afiꞌa fatago osuꞌnae.
Aiyeyaꞌa Yesu ha le konali yaꞌamo ageꞌniyaꞌmofeꞌmo ani agufa gemo huno ava gemo huꞌniye.

Ani gemo huꞌniyaꞌmonanafa asole vayaꞌmo yagaiꞌa neꞌapataya vayaꞌmogimo Yesufeꞌmo apakesa afiꞌa fatago huꞌnayaꞌmonanafa Falasi vayaꞌmogimo mono nopatiꞌmo aliꞌa laha faiꞌa latalegae, huꞌa apakesa afiꞌnayaꞌmofeꞌmo agiꞌamo aeꞌa hakalo huꞌa hapa opaiꞌnae.
Apakaemo ma mopafi vayaꞌmogi ala apakiꞌapimo aliꞌa apamisayafekeꞌmo lusi kava huno hapauꞌniyaꞌmonanafa Gotiꞌa ala apakiꞌapimo alino apamisiyafeꞌmo aiseꞌamo hapauꞌniye.
Yesu geꞌamoꞌmo vayaꞌmo agoti huno apatesiya gemae

Yesuꞌa alopa gefatiꞌmo gemo hunoꞌaeꞌmo, nagaefeꞌmo apakesa afiꞌa fatago nehaya vayaꞌmogimo nagaefekeꞌmo apakesa afiꞌa fatago nosayaꞌmonanafa ani kavaꞌmo huꞌa alino nateꞌnigeꞌna emiꞌneꞌnova vekaꞌefeꞌmo apakesa afiꞌa fatago nehae.
Ina lagimo nageꞌnafi ani kava huꞌa alino nateꞌnigeꞌna emiꞌneꞌnova vekaꞌeꞌmo ageꞌnae.
Apakaemo nagaefeꞌmo apakesa afiꞌa fatago nehaya vayaꞌmo hanipiꞌmo oꞌmaisayafeꞌmo ha le yakana huꞌna ma mopafiꞌmo emiꞌneꞌnove.
Nagaemo geꞌnimo afiteꞌa akame nosisaya vayaꞌmo agoti huꞌna oꞌapategauve. Nagaemo ma mopafi vayaꞌmo agoti huꞌna apatesuvafeꞌmo emiꞌnoꞌmeꞌnofa apakufamo aliꞌna katiꞌna apatesuvafeꞌmo emiꞌneꞌnove.
Mago vayaꞌmogimo geꞌnimo oꞌafiꞌa apakameꞌya neꞌnamisayana agoti huno apategaiye. Ma mopamo alino hano huno atalesiya afinaꞌmo geꞌnimokeꞌmo agoti huno apategaiye.
Nagaemo mani gemo nagaiꞌni nagesafatiꞌmo nagesamo afiꞌna nosufa muki yaꞌmo Afoꞌamoꞌmo alino nateꞌnigeꞌna emiꞌneꞌnova vekamoꞌa ani gemo huvo, huno naha paiꞌniya gemo nehuve.
Afoꞌnimoꞌmo mani gemo huvo, huno naha paiꞌniya gemo ago afiꞌnovana alagepa huꞌa maige maige huꞌa maisaya yaꞌmo alino neꞌapamiya gemo haneꞌnigeꞌna afiteꞌnaeꞌmo hapa nepauve.
